name: SSS ~Three S~
source:
Hero is a prince of a certain country, but he studies in Japan with an actual aim of finding a bride. Can he find his love in just a month from the end of November to December 24th?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是某国王子，来到日本留学的真正目的是寻找新娘。他能在11月底到12月24日这一个月里找到爱情吗？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
